value.rationale: The all-n transition from impossible to possible local reset controls occurs at exactly two consecutive rotation commands in a classical extremal synchronization family. A constructive block embedding supplies a reproducible quadratic reset sequence and a mechanistic explanation, rather than a bare decision algorithm or arbitrary finite example. This addresses a natural restricted-control synchronization parameter; optimal constrained word length is not asserted.
